# discord_thread (Resource)

Manages a thread: a post in a forum or media channel, or a public or private thread in a text or announcement channel, optionally started from an existing message.

Discord archives threads after a period of inactivity and unpins them when they are archived. An archived thread is not treated as drift unless `archived = false` is set, in which case the next apply unarchives it. Changing any other argument of an archived thread unarchives it, unless `archived = true` is set.

The bot needs the Send Messages permission to create a forum or media post, Create Public Threads or Create Private Threads for other threads, and Manage Threads to change `locked`, `rate_limit_per_user` and `pinned` or to delete the thread.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# A post in a forum channel, pinned and tagged.
resource "discord_thread" "faq" {
  channel_id   = discord_forum_channel.help.id
  name         = "Frequently asked questions"
  pinned       = true
  applied_tags = [discord_forum_channel.help.available_tags[0].id]

  message = {
    content = "Read this before opening a new post."
    embeds = [{
      title       = "Getting started"
      description = "Check the docs and search existing posts first."
      color       = provider::discord::color("#5865F2")
    }]
  }
}

# A private thread in a text channel, kept open.
resource "discord_thread" "moderators" {
  channel_id = discord_text_channel.general.id
  name       = "Moderators"
  private    = true
  invitable  = false
  archived   = false
}

# A thread started from an existing message.
resource "discord_thread" "release" {
  channel_id = discord_text_channel.general.id
  message_id = discord_message.release.id
  name       = "Release discussion"
}
```

## Schema

### Required

- `channel_id` (String) ID of the text, announcement, forum or media channel to create the thread in.
- `name` (String) Thread name (1-100 characters).

### Optional

- `applied_tags` (Set of String) IDs of the forum or media channel's tags applied to the post (at most 5), from `discord_forum_channel.available_tags[*].id`.
- `archived` (Boolean) Whether the thread is archived. Leave unset to let Discord archive it after inactivity; set `false` to keep unarchiving it.
- `audit_log_reason` (String) Reason recorded in the server's audit log for creating, changing and deleting the thread (Discord records no reason for editing the starter message), overriding the provider's `audit_log_reason`. Up to 512 characters. Changing only this argument updates state without calling Discord.
- `auto_archive_duration` (Number) Minutes of inactivity after which the thread stops showing in the channel list: `60`, `1440`, `4320` or `10080`. Defaults to the channel's `default_auto_archive_duration`.
- `invitable` (Boolean) Whether members who are not moderators can add other members to a private thread. Requires `private = true`. Discord defaults to `true`.
- `locked` (Boolean) Whether the thread is locked, so only moderators can unarchive it or send messages. Defaults to `false`.
- `message` (Attributes) Starter message of a forum or media post, required to create one. Edits are applied in place. Attachments, components and stickers are not supported yet. An imported post adopts the configured message on the next apply. Removing the argument stops managing the message. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--message))
- `message_id` (String) ID of a message in the text or announcement channel to start the thread from. The thread gets the message's ID, and a message can only have one thread. Changing it replaces the thread. An imported thread adopts the configured value.
- `pinned` (Boolean) Whether the post is pinned to the top of its forum or media channel. A pinned post does not auto-archive, and archiving it unpins it. Conflicts with `archived = true`.
- `private` (Boolean) Whether to create a private thread, visible only to invited members and moderators. Only text channels have private threads. Defaults to `false`.
- `rate_limit_per_user` (Number) Slowmode: seconds a member must wait between messages, between `0` and `21600`. Forum and media posts default to the channel's `default_thread_rate_limit_per_user`.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Thread ID. For a forum or media post it is also the starter message's ID.
- `owner_id` (String) ID of the user that created the thread (the bot).
- `server_id` (String) ID of the server (guild) the thread is in.
- `type` (String) Thread type: `public_thread` (also used for forum and media posts), `private_thread` or `announcement_thread`.

<a id="nestedatt--message"></a>
### Nested Schema for `message`

Optional:

- `allowed_mentions` (Set of String) Mention types that notify people: any of `roles`, `users` and `everyone`. Defaults to none, so posting or editing the message never pings anyone.
- `content` (String) Message text (up to 2000 characters). At least one of `content` or `embeds` is required.
- `embeds` (Attributes List) Rich embeds (at most 10, 6000 characters in total). (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--message--embeds))

<a id="nestedatt--message--embeds"></a>
### Nested Schema for `message.embeds`

Optional:

- `author_icon_url` (String) Author icon URL. Requires `author_name`.
- `author_name` (String) Author name (up to 256 characters).
- `author_url` (String) URL the author name links to. Requires `author_name`.
- `color` (Number) RGB color of the left border. Use `provider::discord::color()` to convert hex.
- `description` (String) Description (up to 4096 characters).
- `fields` (Attributes List) Fields (at most 25). (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--message--embeds--fields))
- `footer_icon_url` (String) Footer icon URL. Requires `footer_text`.
- `footer_text` (String) Footer text (up to 2048 characters).
- `image_url` (String) Image URL.
- `thumbnail_url` (String) Thumbnail URL.
- `title` (String) Title (up to 256 characters).
- `url` (String) URL the title links to.

<a id="nestedatt--message--embeds--fields"></a>
### Nested Schema for `message.embeds.fields`

Required:

- `name` (String) Field name (up to 256 characters).
- `value` (String) Field value (up to 1024 characters).

Optional:

- `inline` (Boolean) Whether the field is displayed inline. Defaults to `false`.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

In Terraform v1.12.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `identity` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = discord_thread.faq
  identity = {
    thread_id = "789012345678901234"
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
### Identity Schema

#### Required

- `thread_id` (String) ID of the thread.

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import discord_thread.faq <thread_id>
```
